summary: Full backend + frontend smoke test for BAITUL MAAL AL-FALAH. Backend: 26/26 pytest cases PASSED covering auth (login/register/me/logout), RBAC (manager/content/fundraising), dashboard role-specific cards, programs CRUD + enrichment (achievement/total_raised/remaining_funds), donations CRUD with inline donor creation, dynamic relationship integrity (Paid donation increases program total_raised, finance total_income, dashboard donations_today; Pending is excluded; expense reduces remaining_funds and increases total_expenses), donors GET with history, expenses CRUD manager-only, tasks with brief upsert and checklist add/toggle/delete with progress auto-calc, finance summary status (SURPLUS/DEFICIT/BALANCED), and reports (financial/expense/fundraising/donation/program/content) with role gating. Frontend: login flow (fill-demo + submit) works, dashboard renders real KPIs (Rp 18.017.901 SURPLUS, income Rp 22.1jt, expense Rp 4.1jt), all 5 bottom tabs navigate correctly for manager (Beranda/Konten/Donasi/Laporan/Profil), fundraising tabs (fr-tab-program/donation/donor) and fr-fab present and functional, all report-* chips found and financial summary renders, profile shows role Manajer + Keluar logout button, Konten tab shows tasks list with checklist %, add-task-fab present. Content role correctly hides Donasi tab (verified: Beranda|Konten|Laporan|Profil only) and only Tugas quick action shown. No red screens or crashes. Deprecation warnings from RN Web (shadow* props, props.pointerEvents) — non-blocking. Google OAuth was NOT tested per instructions (Emergent-managed).

issues: Excel/CSV/PDF export chips visible but not implemented (pending integration — this is expected per problem statement)

react_native_issues.issue: RN Web console deprecation warning: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated. Use 'boxShadow' equivalents via StyleSheet. Search project for shadowColor/shadowOffset/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius and migrate to boxShadow or platform-specific style.

RN Web console deprecation warning: props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents instead. Likely inside Expo Router / gesture handler internals — safe to ignore if third-party, but audit any explicit pointerEvents prop in app code.

action_items: (Optional) Migrate any explicit shadow* props in StyleSheets to boxShadow to silence RN Web deprecation warning.
(Optional) Audit code for pointerEvents={...} props and move them into style objects.
No functional fixes required — all in-scope features work correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is single-file (~1160 lines) and exceeds 700-line guideline — consider splitting into routers/{auth,programs,donations,expenses,tasks,reports}.py for maintainability.
OPENING_BALANCE hardcoded to 0 at module level (line 811); acceptable for MVP but should be a config/DB value for production.
Donation date field stored as ISO string but no server-side validation of format — filter ranges rely on lexicographic ISO comparison which works but is fragile.
load_dotenv + direct os.environ[...] used correctly; MongoDB _id excluded consistently — good.
No pagination on list endpoints (to_list(500/1000/2000/20000)) — fine for demo, plan pagination for scale.
Frontend testIDs are consistent and well-placed across screens — good testability.
seed_data_creation: No new seed data created. Reused server-seeded users/programs/donors/donations/expenses/tasks. Tests create TEST_-prefixed data (donations/expenses/programs/tasks) which are soft-deletable but remain in DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Test suite lives at /app/backend/tests/test_baitulmaal.py. Set EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL env var before running pytest. Seed occurs only if manager@alfalah.id absent, so leftover TEST_ data will not affect re-runs but will accumulate over time — consider adding fixture-level cleanup if flakiness appears. Frontend testIDs verified: login-email, login-password, login-submit, fill-demo, fr-tab-program/donation/donor, fr-fab, report-financial/fundraising/donation/expense/program/content, add-task-fab. Google OAuth flow was NOT automated (Emergent-managed).
